verdict.rationale: Omnara is an agent platform, so automatically opening a pull request on task completion is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents PR creation or any completion-triggered git action. MCP servers, custom tools, skills and event webhooks are developer building blocks a user could wire up, not the capability itself. A community mention of connecting GitHub says nothing about opening pull requests.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure an agent to automatically open a pull request when its task completes
